title.narrative: 1.1 Training programmes on public interest journalism and accountability tools for a total of 180 subeditors and district correspondents of 9 national print, TV and online media outlets

description.narrative: 180 journalists including 153 district correspondents and 27 subeditors/ newsroom editors nominated by the editors and newsroom heads of 9 news outlets participated in inhouse trainings. They learned on how to pitch an indepth, investigative story to the editors. A total of 153 story ideas were developed during the session and 81 story ideas, equally from 9 news outlets were selected by their editors through a comprehensive evaluation process that includes quality of the story ideas, relevance of the issue, investigation plan, accountability part of the story plan and also the capacity of the individual correspondents.

title.narrative: 1.2 Mentorship support on public interest reporting for 81 trained correspondents

description.narrative: As a part of continuation of the productionbased capacity building, 81 trained district correspondents were selected from 9 news outlets nominated by their editors through an evaluation process for a twomonth mentorship support. A total of 17 mentors engaged to support the mentees. 77 mentees completed their production and published 82 reports. Considering the vulnerability of the reporter during the investigation that caused security concern one investigation was dropped and three others could not complete the production for their personal reasons.

description.narrative: Civil society actors keep their eyes on news media to gather information on issues related with electoral reforms, voter list, political violence, level playing field, freedom of expression, violation of human rights particularly of marginalized, pre, during and post election law and order situation, role of development partners and foreign missions and their stand on election observation, thoughts of voters on their entitlement, deprivation from services etc. Information and results generated from the monthly news trend and political analysis reports updated them to get the actual reflection.

title.narrative: Uphold democratic values and strengthen democratic process by promoting fundamental rights and freedoms of citizens

description.narrative: Democracy, rights and freedom of expression have very close connotations and are interlinked. Media is a significant conduit to disseminate peoples views and help people in taking decisions that contributes to consolidate the democratic process. This action will use media in meeting this end.

title.narrative: 1. Service delivery authorities are more accountable to voters.

description.narrative: 1. Service delivery authorities are more accountable to voters.

comment.narrative: Enhanced capacity of the news outlets to produce public interest report will increase numbers of such stories of good quality which will contribute to make democratic institutes more accountable to citizens that helps them plan their roadmap course of action and commitment to citizens.
Geographic location number of news outlets and issues are limited so a moderate impact will be visible in these areas.

title.narrative: 1.4 Engagement programme with 18 newsroom managers of 9 national news outlets

description.narrative: The first programme discussed the importance of public interest stories and find way out how public interest stories can attract media audience, enhance trust in media, and ultimately contribute to the sustainability of news outlets. Throughout the discussion newsroom managers reached a consensus on the idea of collaborating collectively to pursue their common interests. The second interaction thoroughly evaluated the whole process of the capacity building, analysed the stories published, challenges faced, continuation of the effort in future and what role MRDI can play. Some recommendations also surfaced from the discussions.As a followup of the recommendations from second interaction a daylong orientation on public interest reporting and its features was organized for 15 news editors and subeditors of national desks nominated by 8 news outlets to increase the level of understanding on public interest reporting as they are the responsible person for gatekeeping of the reports by the district correspondents.

title.narrative: 1.3 Training programme on DSA, other techlaws, and maintaining digital safety protocols for 120 district correspondents of national media

description.narrative: To create awareness among the district correspondents about the provisions of CSA and how to keep their information safe while handling digital devices, 2day training on digital safety and security was organised in six batches. A total of 119 district correspondents nominated by 15 national print, TV and online news outlets participated in these trainings.
